o: Map the timer to a state: 0 → Green, 30 → Orange, 31..90 → Red, anything else → Invalid. Examples: 60 → Red (in (30, 90]), 5 → Invalid. Pure case analysis, no data structures needed.
k: Exact-match checks for 0 and 30 come first.

a.i: Evaluate the four conditions in order and return the corresponding label.

w: Nothing tricky; just respect the boundary values (0 and 30 are exact matches, 90 is included in Red, 91+ and 1..29 are Invalid). Follow-up: extend to a cyclic signal with periodic phases.
